name: mamaguide-maternal-health-pwa
description: Maternal health companion PWA — stage-aware onboarding, symptom tracking, AI chat, medication safety checker. Full brand system + motion design, runs fully offline in demo mode. React + Vite + Zustand.

paragraphs: MamaGuide is a warm, calming maternal health companion PWA built with React + Vite. It guides mamas through every stage of motherhood — Preconception, Pregnancy, Postpartum, and Early Parenthood — with personalized daily tips, symptom logging, milestone checklists, a safety checker, and an AI chat companion.
features: A 6-step onboarding flow that collects the user's name, journey stage (Preconception / Pregnancy / Postpartum / Early Parenthood), and stage detail (e.g. weeks pregnant). Ends with an optional notification opt-in.
Personalized greeting with the user's name, a daily wellness tip (rotates by day of week), a motivational quote, and quick-access navigation to all core features.
Log daily symptoms, mood, and notes. View a rolling history of past entries with visual indicators. Animated empty state with an encouraging prompt on days with no logs.
Trimester-aware checklist of key milestones and tasks. Checkboxes animate with a spring pop on completion. Progress is persisted across sessions.
Look up whether common medications, foods, and substances are safe during pregnancy and postpartum. Results are categorized as safe, caution, or avoid with explanatory notes.

requirements.text: Login: any email + any password logs in instantly.
Social login: Apple and Google buttons create a demo session immediately.
